TITLE: De-Disinformation
SHORT_DESCRIPTION: Paste a link to a news article or a news site.
LONG_DESCRIPTION: De-Disinformation shows the public registration record of the site a news link points to. The record comes from RDAP, the successor to WHOIS.
HERO.HEADING: Who registered this site?
ERROR.INCORRECT_LINK: That doesn't look like a web link.
